import api
import queueing
import worker

def test_submit_basic():
    """Test basic submit without batch_size (uses default 20)"""
    queue = []
    result = api.submit("owner1", enqueue=queue)
    assert len(queue) == 1
    payload = queue[0]
    assert payload["owner"] == "owner1"
    assert payload["batch_size"] == 20

def test_submit_with_batch_size():
    """Test submit with custom batch_size"""
    queue = []
    result = api.submit("owner2", enqueue=queue, batch_size=50)
    assert len(queue) == 1
    payload = queue[0]
    assert payload["owner"] == "owner2"
    assert payload["batch_size"] == 50
